findings.problem: The phrase 'assessed within ~10 days' is translated as 'evaluadas en ~10 días'. In Spanish, 'en ~10 días' is ambiguous and can be interpreted as 'after 10 days' or 'in 10 days' time, whereas 'within' specifically defines the window from the time of injury.
findings.en: Applies to acute injury, typically age ≥ 18 (validated variants from age 6), assessed within ~10 days, without intoxication or distracting injury.
findings.es: Se aplica a lesiones agudas, en general edad ≥ 18 (variantes validadas desde los 6 años), evaluadas en ~10 días, sin intoxicación ni lesión que distraiga.
